🗣Yuval Noah Harari: Don’t expect killer robots running in the streets. This is not how AI will take over the world.

“It will be the AI bureaucrats.”

“We used language over thousands of years to create the control systems of the world.”

“Banks, the stock market, the legal system these are huge bureaucratic networks ultimately based on language.”

“AI is a bureaucratic native.”

“What happens when something comes along that is better than us at bureaucracy, finance and law?”


@aipost 🏴

🗣Jensen Huang: Go to school and engage AI. Those are the two things I tell my kids.

“Scaring kids into believing they don’t need school anymore is a disservice to society.”

“Your education is going to be worthwhile.”

“Engage AI. Learn what it can do. Make it work for you.”

“Let it expand your capabilities so your aspirations can be even greater.”

“Believing that going to school is a waste of time and money is absolutely horrible.”
